title: [Audit] System index requests (raw)
description: The newest 1,000 requests against .kibana*, .security*, .alerts-* and other system indices, one row per index named: privileged data access worth a second look. Ordinary data-stream backing indices are left out.
esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE ((elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-*") OR elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-.*") AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*") | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 1000 | EVAL actor = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, user.email, api_key.name IS NOT NULL, api_key.name, user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", CONCAT(user.name, " · Cloud API key"), user.domain == "_es_api_key", CONCAT("Unnamed key of ", user.name), user.name IS NOT NULL, user.name, "(unattributed)") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, elasticsearch.audit.action, elasticsearch.audit.indices, client.ip | EVAL actor = REPLACE(REPLACE(actor, "^([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15} · Cloud API key$", "$1… · Cloud API key"), "^Unnamed key of ([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15}$", "Unnamed key of $1…") | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, elasticsearch.audit.action AS `Transport action`, client.ip AS `Client IP`, elasticsearch.audit.indices AS Index
